characters.prompt: Create ONE single photorealistic cinematic film still in 16:9 widescreen — one frame only, NOT a grid, no panels, no borders, no captions. REAL PHOTOGRAPH ONLY: a frame from a live-action Japanese drama shot on a cinema camera — real human skin with pores and fine lines, real fabric weave, real wood grain; NOT an illustration, NOT anime, NOT a painting, NOT CGI. EXPRESSION FIRST — the face must read clearly at a glance on a phone screen, at about 60 percent intensity, overriding the neutral expression of any reference image: Expression — SILENT HURT: eyes lowered or just lifting, brows slightly drawn, the lower lids tight, the mouth closed and the lips pressed flat with a faint downward tug at one corner, a small swallow visible at the throat; the face of someone absorbing an insult without replying. ACTING REALISM: this is a real actor caught mid-thought, not a posed portrait — a subtle NATURAL ASYMMETRY between the two sides of the face, the emotion held mainly in the EYES and the tiny muscles around them (lower eyelids, inner brows, nostrils, the corners of the mouth), the skin reacting (faint flush or pallor where the emotion demands), a believable breath in the chest; NO exaggerated theatrical grimace, NO stock smile with teeth, NO blank mannequin stare, NO perfectly symmetrical frozen face. Photorealistic live-action Japanese drama, authentic contemporary Japanese hot-spring inn (温泉旅館) mise-en-scene, Reiwa era, Arri Alexa cinematic color grade, Kodak 35mm film grain, 24fps, 16:9, quiet elegant realism, no flat lighting. LOCATION FIRST: the scene takes place in the location of reference image 2; the room, furniture and background of reference image 1 must NOT appear — only its face is used. [CAMERA] MOBILE-FIRST COMPOSITION: this will be watched on a 6-inch phone screen — the key subject (face, hand or object) is LARGE and centred in the middle 60 percent of the frame, high local contrast between subject and background, nothing important near the frame edges or in tiny far-off detail; the lower fifth of the frame stays visually simple (subtitles will sit there). eye-level, 85mm prime lens, f/1.8, shallow depth of field, razor-sharp focus on the irises, soft optical bokeh, cinematic portrait. Only the people described (1 named), no extra sharp faces. [CHARACTER] Reference image 1 is the APPROVED keyframe face of Wakana (33, slim, soft oval face, clear dark eyes, straight black hair in a low neat chignon with NO bangs, two small beauty marks below the LEFT eye, NO glasses; plain dark-navy kimono with an ivory obi): reproduce exactly this face, hair, eyewear and wardrobe; ignore its background and framing unless the description below says otherwise. Reference image 2 is the location reference: match its architecture, colours, set dressing and light direction; ignore any borders or labels. IDENTITY FIRST: the person is EXACTLY the one in reference image 1 — same face shape, jaw, cheekbones, nose, eyes, eyebrows, skin tone, age, hairstyle and eyewear; only the expression, lighting and framing described below change. Wakana, a Japanese woman aged 33, slim, soft oval face, clear dark eyes, straight black hair combed back into a low neat chignon with NO bangs, small beauty marks below the LEFT eye, NO glasses, wearing a formal plain navy-blue silk kimono with no pattern and a plain ivory obi sash, white tabi socks, no crest, no jewellery. [ACTION] Chest-up close-up of Wakana looking down after the call, NOT smiling, lips closed, eyes lowered, a quiet unreadable face with a trace of old hurt, the desk lamp glowing on one side, town lights blurred behind. [SETTING] Lighting: night, a warm desk lamp and the soft lantern lights of the hot-spring town through the window, gentle low contrast.  All papers, screens, signs, scrolls, plates and the noren curtain are completely blank and plain; no letters, numbers, crests or symbols anywhere in the frame; every wall is bare. SETTING: the place is reference image 2 ONLY; the background, furniture, lamps and lighting of reference image 1 must NOT appear. WALL RULE: every wall is completely bare — NO paper notices, NO posters, NO calendars, NO framed writing; NO noren curtain and NO hanging cloth unless the location reference shows one, and then it is plain solid indigo with NO circular crest. Hanaikada office: binders, papers and the desk calendar are blank; the laptop screen is a plain soft glow; bare walls, NO noren. Full-frame 16:9 image filling the whole canvas: NO black bars, NO white borders, NO letterbox or pillarbox.
